services.name: School Programs
services.desc: The programs below are only available at the T.rex Discovery Centre on #1 T. rex Drive, in the Town of Eastend, Saskatchewan. School programs in Regina can be found here. Frills, spikes, teeth, and plates - these adaptations helped dinosaurs survive! Students will learn about the meaning behind dinosaur names and create their own dinosaur drawing to keep. Get up close with dinosaur teeth to see the differences between theirs and our own. Examine a variety of dinosaur teeth and paint a replica “Scotty” tooth to keep! services.name: Day pass
services.desc: Bring a family member, pal, or partner and create still-life Memento-Mori drawings of taxidermy animals and other spooky objects from the Royal Saskatchewan Museum collection. Just meet us in the Learning LAB and we'll supply all the materials. Great for all ages and abilities. Youth under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at all times. This program is offered in partnership between Dunlop Art Gallery and the Royal Saskatchewan Museum. Donating to the Royal Saskatchewan Museum funds our scientists and the active science research that they do.
